summary: Bull Shoals Mountain appears only as a name and county on one lookout listing, which spells the county Marian; no other source confirms a tower or its condition.

corrections.why: The Encyclopedia of Arkansas places Bull Shoals in Marion County, and 'Marian' looks like a misspelling. The mountain's county is inferred from the town, not stated directly.

evidence.supports: a lookout named Bull Shoals Mountain is listed
the listing gives the county as Marian County
Bull Shoals is in Marion County
evidence.quote: Bull Shoals is located in Marion County

evidence.supports: Roy Danuser established tourist attractions associated with Bull Shoals
evidence.quote: Roy Danuser established a number of tourist attractions

evidence.supports: a tourist tower atop a Bull Mountain, made from old offshore drilling platforms; not described as a forestry lookout
evidence.quote: The tower, atop Bull Mountain, was made from old offshore drilling platforms

notes_for_editor: The only evidence is a one-line listing with a name and county. Two web searches and the Encyclopedia of Arkansas and Preserve Arkansas pages named no tower on this mountain. The Top O' the Ozarks tourist tower on a Bull Mountain near Bull Shoals may be confused with this record; it is not described as a forestry lookout. The story is 164 words after verification, above the 120-word floor, and was not padded. Recommend holding it until a source turns up. The record's coordinates (36.3635, -92.5986) are not verified by any source read.
